definitions.explanation: A job or position someone can get: an opening for work. Usual in talk about finding work, especially when jobs are scarce.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{働|はたら}き{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are few jobs for young people in the countryside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{働|はたら}き{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Through an acquaintance, I finally found a job at a factory in the neighborhood.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work) and ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (opening). A little old-fashioned and conversational; job ads and official texts say ⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧ or {就職先|しゅうしょくさき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for work
- {働|はたら}き{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: to find a job
- {働|はたら}き{口|ぐち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: work, job — the general word
- {勤|つと}め{口|ぐち}: a post, employment — very close, slightly more formal
